svg.title: hapax: the stages of one run, where a library ends up, and what one row says
svg.desc: Panel a lists the seven stages of a run, each with its input, its output and one measured quantity: resolve, 14 nt non-template prefix on mate 2, modal in 5/5 seeds; merge, 35.1% of pairs merge; recognition at 20% divergence 10.5 → 38.4%; assemble, 20 of 25 depositor genomes at ≥90% breadth; 53 zero-read controls stay empty; identify, 77.10% of read pairs removed as already known (77.02–77.28, 5 seeds); score the distance, 0.00% shuffled null, carried beside every field rather than quoted once; report the residue, depth 1 median, for the pairs that never assembled — a boundary, not a pile of candidates; subtract other plants, 87.5% of a held-out library, still falling at 512 libraries. Panel b is a to-scale bar of 100% of read pairs: 77.10% identified, made up of ribosomal, 37.93 points, the sample's own contigs, 30.33, everything else, 8.84, and 22.90% residue, of which ≈8.4 assembled but unnameable, ≈11.1 never assembled. Panel c is the one distance axis every row sits on, running from far from anything published to matched, each row carrying what it is closest to.
svg.text: What is already known, what assembled without a name, and how far the rest sits from anything published — each pile quantified, each answer priced.
one input, one output, one measured quantity each

of pairs merge; recognition at 20% divergence 10.5 → 38.4%

shuffled null, carried beside every field rather than quoted once
report the residue
what nothing named → one un-thresholded row per pair, each field with its control
depth 1
median, for the pairs that never assembled — a boundary, not a pile of candidates
subtract other plants
512 libraries from elsewhere → witnessed or not, paired per plant
of a held-out library, still falling at 512 libraries

svg.text: A stage whose input is missing is skipped by name and the run is marked incomplete. Nothing falls back to a cheaper index, and no sample's parameters are guessed.

0.015 GB of the sample's own contigs removes 30.33 points where 16 GB of Kraken2 removes 0.42, which is why the cascade is ordered by cost and not by size.
far from anything published
matched
One mark per contig, un-thresholded, each carrying what it is closest to
beside how far away that is — both halves, or the missing half is named.
No novelty score, no threat score, no per-read verdict: a search can say
whether something is already known, never that something is new.

svg.text: Berlin wastewater SRR23973193, 5 seeds; percentages are of read pairs. Every number here is read from a committed result directory under results/, with the script and seed that produced it.
